product-research.description.zh-CN: 独立于单次投资持续运行，沉淀可复用、可追溯的产品研究结论与产品池。
product-research.description.en-US: Continuous product research with reusable, traceable conclusions and product pools.

pre-investment.description.zh-CN: 针对单个组合，自上而下完成目标定义、大类配置、产品配置研究、方案定稿与外部审批结果记录。
pre-investment.description.en-US: Define objectives, research asset and product allocation, finalize proposals and record external approvals.

portfolio-center.description.zh-CN: 统一登记真实组合及其研究方案、账户、核算主体、账簿和生命周期关系，是投中、基金会计与投后的共同主数据入口。
portfolio-center.description.en-US: Maintain portfolios, proposals, accounts, accounting entities, books and lifecycle relationships in a shared master-data hub.

investment-execution.description.zh-CN: 基于组合中心登记的真实组合，完成方案落地、交易计划测算、执行结果衔接、资金核对和再平衡研究；不提供下单能力。
investment-execution.description.en-US: Support implementation, trade planning, execution records, cash reconciliation and rebalancing research. No order placement is provided.

fund-accounting.description.zh-CN: 与投资决策线并行并贯穿投中、投后，把业务事实转换为各核算主体独立平衡的复式凭证、账簿、估值、报表与绩效数据；当前仅为研究平台静态框架。
fund-accounting.description.en-US: Translate business facts into balanced entries, ledgers, valuations, statements and performance data for each entity. Currently a static research-platform framework.

post-investment.description.zh-CN: 基于会计核算形成的实际组合事实，解释投资结果、识别收益与风险来源并形成可审计的研究结论。
post-investment.description.en-US: Explain realized results, identify return and risk sources, and record auditable conclusions using accounting facts.

feedback.description.zh-CN: 把实际投资结果反馈给产品研究、配置模型和投资流程，形成可审计的持续改进。
feedback.description.en-US: Feed realized results back into product research, allocation models and investment processes.

portfolio-solutions.description.zh-CN: 承接已定稿的组合研究版本，形成面向产品、渠道与客户的标准化组合展示；不参与单个组合的研究决策闭环。
portfolio-solutions.description.en-US: Present finalized portfolio research to products, distribution channels and clients, independently of portfolio decision workflows.

settings.description.zh-CN: 统一管理数据、研究口径、指标、情景算法、回测、规则版本和公共参数，不进入单个组合的投资主流程。
settings.description.en-US: Manage shared data, research conventions, indicators, scenario algorithms, backtests, versioned rules, language and parameters.

product-research.panorama.description.zh-CN: 展示 ETF 与场外公募基金的市场规模、产品分布、关键指标和研究入口。
product-research.panorama.description.en-US: Explore market size, product distribution, key metrics and research tools for ETFs and non-exchange-traded mutual funds.

product-research.products.description.zh-CN: 研究产品业绩、风险、风格、费用、流动性及管理人。
product-research.products.description.en-US: Research product performance, risk, style, fees, liquidity and fund managers.

product-research.holding-style.descripti.zh-CN: 区分披露持仓与估算暴露，研究底层资产、行业风格、因子暴露及披露时滞。
product-research.holding-style.descripti.en-US: Distinguish disclosed holdings from estimated exposures, and study underlying assets, sector and style exposures, factor exposures and disclosure lags.

product-research.evaluation.description.zh-CN: 通过版本化指标方案完成产品评价、排名与分类。
product-research.evaluation.description.en-US: Evaluate, rank and classify products using versioned metric plans.

product-research.timing.description.zh-CN: 用可编辑规则研究 ETF 入场与退出，比较样本外、年度和月度表现，并保存研究版本。
product-research.timing.description.en-US: Study ETF entry and exit rules, compare out-of-sample, annual and monthly performance, and save research versions.

product-research.pools.description.zh-CN: 直接引用多套产品评价方案，结合人工研究形成可复用产品池。
product-research.pools.description.en-US: Combine multiple product evaluation plans with analyst research to build reusable product pools.

product-research.pool-lifecycle.zh-CN: 产品池版本与生命周期管理

product-research.pool-lifecycle.descript.zh-CN: 管理不可变版本、生效状态、成员变化与研究证据。
product-research.pool-lifecycle.descript.en-US: Manage immutable versions, effective status, membership changes and research evidence.

pre-investment.ltcma.description.zh-CN: 独立研究长期资本市场假设，管理冻结版本，供 SAA 选择引用。
pre-investment.ltcma.description.en-US: Research long-term capital market assumptions and manage frozen versions for SAA.

pre-investment.saa.allocation-lab.zh-CN: 大类资产配置与策略回测

investment-execution.trade-plan.zh-CN: 目标组合与交易计划测算

investment-execution.trade-allocation.zh-CN: 汇总订单与公平交易分配

fund-accounting.policy.zh-CN: 核算主体、账簿与记账规则

fund-accounting.account-statements.zh-CN: 外部账户流水、拆分与结算匹配
fund-accounting.account-statements.en-US: Account statements, allocation and settlement matching

fund-accounting.booking.zh-CN: 组合 Booking 与复式记账

fund-accounting.portfolio-ledger.zh-CN: 组合/基金总账与明细账

fund-accounting.valuation-nav.zh-CN: 估值、应计与净资产核算

post-investment.portfolio-data.zh-CN: 实际组合数据与三账核对

post-investment.monitoring.zh-CN: 持仓产品与管理人监控

feedback.product-review.zh-CN: 产品复审与产品池更新

settings.language-terminology.descriptio.zh-CN: 查看内置系统翻译，维护独立的业务术语与多语言覆盖。
settings.language-terminology.descriptio.en-US: View read-only system translations and manage separate multilingual business terminology.

settings.risk-scales.description.zh-CN: 以参考资产与市场假设建立可追溯的 C1–C5 风险标尺，管理不可变版本和当前默认。
settings.risk-scales.description.en-US: Build traceable C1–C5 risk scales from reference assets and market assumptions; manage immutable versions and defaults.

pre-investment.objectives.description.zh-CN: 设置收益目标、最大风险等级与现金需求；风险标尺提供冻结参考参数和C1–C5，正式CMA留到后续研究。
pre-investment.objectives.description.en-US: Set return targets, maximum risk level and cash needs. The risk scale provides frozen reference parameters and C1–C5 levels; formal CMA is researched later.

pre-investment.product-pool.description.zh-CN: 选定投资目标，选择 Product first 或 Strategy first 研究路径，并锁定本次投前研究的对应范围。
pre-investment.product-pool.description.en-US: Select an investment objective, choose Product first or Strategy first, and lock the scope for this study.

pre-investment.saa.description.zh-CN: 确定大类资产中枢权重、偏离区间与长期风险预算。
pre-investment.saa.description.en-US: Set strategic asset-class weights, deviation ranges and long-term risk budgets.

pre-investment.taa.description.zh-CN: 锁定 SAA，研究相对强弱或观点偏离，比较含成本回测与情景影响，并将已保存的大类预算传入产品配置。
pre-investment.taa.description.en-US: Lock SAA, research relative strength or view-based deviations, compare backtests after costs and scenario impacts, then pass saved asset-class budgets to product allocation.

pre-investment.product-allocation-timing.zh-CN: 承接 SAA 或 TAA，核对产品权重、实际风险、费用和剩余资金；保留历史组合与择时研究入口。
pre-investment.product-allocation-timing.en-US: Continue from SAA or TAA and check product weights, actual risk, costs and remaining funding. Historical portfolio and timing research remain available.

pre-investment.portfolio-synthesis.descr.zh-CN: 汇总同一候选的来源、产品风险、费用、现金与验证证据，保留完整版本。
pre-investment.portfolio-synthesis.descr.en-US: Combine sources, product risk, costs, cash and validation evidence for the same candidate in a complete version.

pre-investment.validation.description.zh-CN: 锁定候选，复核产品风险、成本、剩余付款和选定情景；缺失证据明确列出。
pre-investment.validation.description.en-US: Lock a candidate and review product risk, costs, remaining payments and selected scenarios. Missing evidence is listed explicitly.

pre-investment.approval.description.zh-CN: 核对同一份验证报告，记录理由与复核日期，冻结并导出研究包。
pre-investment.approval.description.en-US: Review the same validation report, record rationale and review dates, then freeze and export the research package.

pre-investment.saa.policy.description.zh-CN: 经济大类、长期资本市场假设、稳健候选与政策确认。
pre-investment.saa.policy.description.en-US: Economic asset classes, long-term assumptions, robust candidates and policy confirmation.

pre-investment.saa.asset-classes.descrip.zh-CN: 定义大类及其 ETF/公募基金代理。
pre-investment.saa.asset-classes.descrip.en-US: Define asset classes and their ETF or mutual fund proxies.

pre-investment.saa.auto-classification.d.zh-CN: 按收益相关性、风险画像或主成分自动划分大类，并给出代表产品、类内权重与分类诊断。
pre-investment.saa.auto-classification.d.en-US: Group assets by return correlations, risk profiles or principal components, with representative products, within-class weights and classification diagnostics.

pre-investment.saa.allocation-lab.descri.zh-CN: 效率前沿、风险预算、目标权重、调仓与回测。
pre-investment.saa.allocation-lab.descri.en-US: Efficient frontiers, risk budgets, target weights, rebalancing and backtesting.

pre-investment.product-allocation-timing.zh-CN: 查看与引用已冻结的择时研究版本；不自动交易或改变组合权重。
pre-investment.product-allocation-timing.en-US: View and reference frozen timing research versions without automatic trading or changes to portfolio weights.

settings.llm-api.description.zh-CN: 管理 AI 助手的大模型 API 配置，指定当前使用的服务；密钥仅显示脱敏结果。
settings.llm-api.description.en-US: Manage model API profiles for the AI assistant and select the active service. Keys are masked.

investment-execution.onboarding.descript.zh-CN: 把外部已批准的目标组合版本关联至真实组合并登记平台主数据，不代替基金设立、开户或审批。
investment-execution.onboarding.descript.en-US: Link an externally approved target portfolio version to an actual portfolio and register its platform master data. This does not replace fund establishment, account opening or approval.

investment-execution.trade-plan.descript.zh-CN: 结合资金、持仓、容量和交收周期测算组合级交易计划。
investment-execution.trade-plan.descript.en-US: Estimate portfolio trade plans using cash, holdings, capacity and settlement cycles.

investment-execution.pre-trade-check.des.zh-CN: 检查现金、申赎、容量、费用、流动性与投资限制。
investment-execution.pre-trade-check.des.en-US: Check cash, subscriptions and redemptions, capacity, fees, liquidity and investment restrictions.

investment-execution.trade-allocation.de.zh-CN: 汇总多个组合和基金经理的独立指令，并把成交按冻结规则拆回组合、投资单元和结算账户。
investment-execution.trade-allocation.de.en-US: Aggregate independent instructions from portfolios and fund managers, then allocate fills to portfolios, sleeves and settlement accounts using frozen rules.

investment-execution.cash-settlement.des.zh-CN: 按 ETF 与场外基金的资金可用日、申赎时滞测算在途资金和现金拖累。
investment-execution.cash-settlement.des.en-US: Estimate unsettled cash and cash drag using ETF and mutual fund cash availability dates and subscription or redemption delays.

investment-execution.booking.description.zh-CN: 先拆分执行通道、银行与托管原始记录，再把完成组合归属的事实交由基金会计。
investment-execution.booking.description.en-US: Allocate original execution-channel, bank and custody records before handing portfolio-assigned facts to fund accounting.

investment-execution.reconciliation.desc.zh-CN: 从投资视角核对现金、份额、成本和目标组合之间的差异。
investment-execution.reconciliation.desc.en-US: Reconcile differences in cash, units, costs and target allocations from an investment perspective.

investment-execution.rebalancing.descrip.zh-CN: 测算权重偏离与再平衡方案，并记录研究过程。
investment-execution.rebalancing.descrip.en-US: Estimate weight deviations and rebalancing plans, and record the research process.

portfolio-center.register.description.zh-CN: 查看真实组合清单、类型、运行状态及关键责任主体。
portfolio-center.register.description.en-US: View actual portfolios, their types, operating status and responsible entities.

portfolio-center.master.description.zh-CN: 维护组合身份、策略、基准、币种、管理人、托管人和生效日期。
portfolio-center.master.description.en-US: Maintain portfolio identity, strategy, benchmark, currency, manager, custodian and effective dates.

portfolio-center.accounts.description.zh-CN: 独立维护执行、资金、托管和 TA 账户，并按账户类型控制是否允许关联多个组合。
portfolio-center.accounts.description.en-US: Maintain execution, cash, custody and transfer-agent accounts separately, with account-type rules governing links to multiple portfolios.

portfolio-center.responsibilities.descri.zh-CN: 按有效期关联真实组合、内部 Sleeve、基金经理角色与管理人法人。
portfolio-center.responsibilities.descri.en-US: Link actual portfolios, internal sleeves, fund manager roles and management companies by effective date.

portfolio-center.versions.description.zh-CN: 追溯来源研究方案、外部批准记录和历次目标组合版本。
portfolio-center.versions.description.en-US: Trace source research plans, external approvals and historical target portfolio versions.

portfolio-center.lifecycle.description.zh-CN: 记录筹备、待启用、运行、暂停、清算和终止等状态变化。
portfolio-center.lifecycle.description.en-US: Record status changes through preparation, pending activation, operation, suspension, liquidation and termination.

fund-accounting.policy.description.zh-CN: 关联组合中心已有主体与账簿，并定义科目表、正常余额、确认计量、凭证模板和报表政策。
fund-accounting.policy.description.en-US: Link existing entities and books from the portfolio center, and define charts of accounts, normal balances, recognition and measurement rules, journal templates and reporting policies.

fund-accounting.account-statements.descr.zh-CN: 保存执行通道、银行及托管原始记录，按分配关系拆到组合并处理待认领悬账。
fund-accounting.account-statements.descr.en-US: Retain original execution-channel, bank and custody records, allocate them to portfolios and resolve unassigned suspense items.

fund-accounting.booking.description.zh-CN: 承接已完成账户和组合分配的业务事实，按核算主体、会计时点和政策版本生成借贷平衡凭证草稿。
fund-accounting.booking.description.en-US: Turn business facts with completed account and portfolio allocations into balanced journal drafts by accounting entity, accounting date and policy version.

fund-accounting.portfolio-ledger.descrip.zh-CN: 每只组合或基金独立过账，形成总账、明细账、试算平衡、持仓、现金、净资产及表外备查簿。
fund-accounting.portfolio-ledger.descrip.en-US: Post separately for each portfolio or fund to produce general and subsidiary ledgers, trial balances, holdings, cash, net assets and memorandum records.

fund-accounting.manager-ledger.descripti.zh-CN: 记录管理费、自有资金跟投及管理人自身业务，并与公司财务系统保持接口边界。
fund-accounting.manager-ledger.descripti.en-US: Record management fees, proprietary co-investments and the manager's own business, with a defined interface to corporate finance systems.

fund-accounting.valuation-nav.descriptio.zh-CN: 处理公允价值、利息与费用应计、汇率、份额和净资产，并保留估值调整版本。
fund-accounting.valuation-nav.descriptio.en-US: Process fair values, accrued interest and fees, exchange rates, units and net assets, while retaining valuation adjustment versions.

fund-accounting.cross-book-reconciliatio.zh-CN: 核对 Booking、组合/基金账、管理人账、托管与银行数据，处理差错并冻结各自账期版本。
fund-accounting.cross-book-reconciliatio.en-US: Reconcile Booking, portfolio or fund books, manager books, custody and bank data; resolve errors and freeze each accounting period version.

fund-accounting.financial-statements.des.zh-CN: 分别生成组合/基金报表和管理人公司报表视图，不直接混加；合并仅作为需单独判断的会计事项。
fund-accounting.financial-statements.des.en-US: Produce separate portfolio or fund statements and management-company statements. Consolidation requires a separate accounting assessment.

fund-accounting.performance-dataset.desc.zh-CN: 输出冻结估值、外部资金流、内部交易、费用和基准口径，供组合层 TWR、MWR/XIRR 与归因计算。
fund-accounting.performance-dataset.desc.en-US: Provide frozen valuations, external cash flows, internal trades, fees and benchmark conventions for portfolio TWR, MWR/XIRR and attribution.

post-investment.portfolio-data.descripti.zh-CN: 读取并核对 IBOR、ABOR、PBOR 的交易、持仓、现金、费用、外部资金流和估值快照。
post-investment.portfolio-data.descripti.en-US: Read and reconcile IBOR, ABOR and PBOR trades, holdings, cash, fees, external cash flows and valuation snapshots.

post-investment.performance.description.zh-CN: 基于冻结估值与外部资金流计算 TWR、XIRR、风险和相对基准表现，不把内部买卖当作申赎。
post-investment.performance.description.en-US: Calculate TWR, XIRR, risk and benchmark-relative performance from frozen valuations and external cash flows; internal trades are not subscriptions or redemptions.

post-investment.return-attribution.descr.zh-CN: 拆解配置、择时、产品选择、交互与执行偏差。
post-investment.return-attribution.descr.en-US: Break down allocation, timing, product selection, interaction and execution effects.

post-investment.risk-attribution.descrip.zh-CN: 分析大类、产品、行业风格与风险因子的贡献。
post-investment.risk-attribution.descrip.en-US: Analyze contributions from asset classes, products, sectors, styles and risk factors.

post-investment.monitoring.description.zh-CN: 跟踪业绩、风格漂移、规模、流动性和团队变化。
post-investment.monitoring.description.en-US: Track performance, style drift, assets under management, liquidity and team changes.

post-investment.scenarios.description.zh-CN: 评估历史或自定义冲击下的组合损失与流动性风险。
post-investment.scenarios.description.en-US: Assess portfolio losses and liquidity risk under historical or custom shocks.

post-investment.conclusions.description.zh-CN: 固化基于业绩、归因、监控和情景分析形成的研究结论。
post-investment.conclusions.description.en-US: Freeze research conclusions based on performance, attribution, monitoring and scenario analysis.

post-investment.reports.description.zh-CN: 归档投资结果、原因解释、风险提示和相关版本。
post-investment.reports.description.en-US: Archive investment results, explanations, risk disclosures and related versions.

post-investment.accounting-reports.descr.zh-CN: 查看组合/基金账生成的三张核心报表、附注及报表间勾稽结果。
post-investment.accounting-reports.descr.en-US: View the three core statements, notes and cross-statement reconciliation results from portfolio or fund books.

post-investment.research-diagnosis.descr.zh-CN: 基于不可变研究快照查看净值、贡献、矩阵和历史情景。
post-investment.research-diagnosis.descr.en-US: Inspect net asset values, contributions, matrices and historical scenarios using immutable research snapshots.

feedback.results.description.zh-CN: 汇集实际收益、风险、归因、执行偏差和投后事件。
feedback.results.description.en-US: Collect realized returns, risk, attribution, execution deviations and post-investment events.

feedback.hypothesis-review.description.zh-CN: 比较投前假设与实际结果并解释差异来源。
feedback.hypothesis-review.description.en-US: Compare pre-investment assumptions with actual results and explain the differences.

feedback.product-review.description.zh-CN: 重新评价相关产品并发布新的产品池版本。
feedback.product-review.description.en-US: Reassess relevant products and publish new product pool versions.

feedback.model-update.description.zh-CN: 评估并更新配置、择时、风险预算和再平衡参数。
feedback.model-update.description.en-US: Evaluate and update allocation, timing, risk budgets and rebalancing parameters.

feedback.rolling-validation.description.zh-CN: 通过样本外和敏感性分析验证改进稳定性。
feedback.rolling-validation.description.en-US: Use out-of-sample testing and sensitivity analysis to assess the stability of improvements.

feedback.process-improvement.description.zh-CN: 把复盘结论固化为新的流程、规则和控制要求。
feedback.process-improvement.description.en-US: Turn review findings into updated processes, rules and controls.

portfolio-solutions.catalog.description.zh-CN: 按风险等级、期限、策略类型和发布状态管理可展示的组合方案。
portfolio-solutions.catalog.description.en-US: Manage portfolio solutions for presentation by risk level, horizon, strategy type and publication status.

portfolio-solutions.profile.description.zh-CN: 展示组合定位、目标、风险等级、适用客群、配置中枢和服务边界。
portfolio-solutions.profile.description.en-US: Present portfolio positioning, objectives, risk level, intended clients, target allocation and service boundaries.

portfolio-solutions.performance.descript.zh-CN: 按统一口径展示组合、基准、回撤、风险指标和分阶段表现。
portfolio-solutions.performance.descript.en-US: Present portfolio and benchmark performance, drawdowns, risk metrics and period results using consistent conventions.

portfolio-solutions.backtest.description.zh-CN: 展示冻结版本的样本内外回测、成本假设、再平衡规则和稳健性结果。
portfolio-solutions.backtest.description.en-US: Present frozen in-sample and out-of-sample backtests, cost assumptions, rebalancing rules and robustness results.

portfolio-solutions.scenarios.descriptio.zh-CN: 展示不同经济周期、历史危机和自定义冲击下的模拟表现。
portfolio-solutions.scenarios.descriptio.en-US: Present simulated performance across economic cycles, historical crises and custom shocks.

portfolio-solutions.rules.description.zh-CN: 说明资产范围、配置中枢、信号输入、约束、调仓频率和算法版本。
portfolio-solutions.rules.description.en-US: Explain the asset scope, target allocation, signal inputs, constraints, rebalancing frequency and algorithm versions.

portfolio-solutions.publishing.descripti.zh-CN: 冻结基准、费用、数据日期、回测标识、风险揭示和对外展示版本。
portfolio-solutions.publishing.descripti.en-US: Freeze benchmarks, fees, data dates, backtest labels, risk disclosures and externally presented versions.

settings.data-sources.description.zh-CN: 日常更新入口：选择需要的数据，确认增量或全量，查看进度并恢复中断任务。
settings.data-sources.description.en-US: Select data for daily updates, choose incremental or full downloads, track progress and resume interrupted tasks.

settings.source-center.description.zh-CN: 首次接入或修改配置时使用；Tushare 已预置，支持字段映射、限制设置和样本验证。
settings.source-center.description.en-US: Set up or change data connections. Tushare is preconfigured, with field mapping, limit settings and sample validation.

settings.data-model.description.zh-CN: 查看外部数据需要映射的标准表与字段；系统内部结构在高级入口中查看。
settings.data-model.description.en-US: Inspect standard tables and fields for mapping external data. Advanced views show internal system structures.

settings.data-quality.description.zh-CN: 监控完整性、及时性、唯一性、产品映射、账户对账和异常处理状态。
settings.data-quality.description.en-US: Monitor completeness, timeliness, uniqueness, product mapping, account reconciliation and exception handling.

settings.research-data-lab.description.zh-CN: 搜索并检查指数、宏观、指标版本与上传序列，研究覆盖、缺失、PIT 和时序表现后加入计算图。
settings.research-data-lab.description.en-US: Search and inspect indices, macro data, indicator versions and uploaded series. Review coverage, missing values, PIT and time-series behavior before adding data to calculation graphs.

settings.pit-snapshots.description.zh-CN: 体检每张表的事件时间与可得时间、公告滞后与 PIT 等级，并对数据整体封版，供研究上下文引用。
settings.pit-snapshots.description.en-US: Inspect event and availability timestamps, announcement delays and PIT grades for each table, then freeze a complete data snapshot for research contexts.

settings.research-parameters.description.zh-CN: 维护可复用、版本化的基准、无风险利率、数据处理和计算口径模板，供产品与组合研究引用。
settings.research-parameters.description.en-US: Maintain reusable, versioned templates for benchmarks, risk-free rates, data processing and calculation conventions for product and portfolio research.

settings.indicators-models.description.zh-CN: 基于净值、价格和指数等行情序列，维护标量、矩阵及组合指标的定义、公式、范围和版本。
settings.indicators-models.description.en-US: Maintain definitions, formulas, scopes and versions for scalar, matrix and composite indicators built on NAV, price and index series.

settings.position-metrics.description.zh-CN: 基于交易记录、持仓和现金流，定义持仓成本、已实现与未实现损益、TWR/MWR 等投中投后指标。
settings.position-metrics.description.en-US: Define in-trade and post-trade metrics such as cost basis, realized and unrealized P&L and TWR/MWR from transactions, holdings and cash flows.

settings.factor-research.description.zh-CN: 构建和检验共享因子，区分比较基准、模型与数据来源，发布研究版本并接入产品池和投研证据。
settings.factor-research.description.en-US: Build and test shared factors, distinguish benchmarks, models and data sources, and publish research versions for product pools and investment research evidence.

settings.risk-models.description.zh-CN: 研究并验证产品敏感度、现金流久期与凸度；发布到统一数据磁盘，供产品与组合直接读取。
settings.risk-models.description.en-US: Research and validate product sensitivities, cash-flow duration and convexity; publish to the shared data disk for product and portfolio use.

settings.timing-algorithms.description.zh-CN: 复用指标计算与条件规则，编辑、保存并检验可展开的产品择时算法。
settings.timing-algorithms.description.en-US: Reuse indicator calculations and conditional rules to edit, save and test product timing algorithms with inspectable steps.

settings.scenario-algorithms.description.zh-CN: 历史情景识别与模拟分开；从事件、宏观变量或市场冲击构建已发布情景，复用风险模型进行产品和组合压测。
settings.scenario-algorithms.description.en-US: Separate historical regime identification from simulation. Build published scenarios from events, macro variables or market shocks, and reuse risk models for product and portfolio stress tests.

settings.backtest-center.description.zh-CN: 管理回测引擎、规则模板、运行任务和结果档案。
settings.backtest-center.description.en-US: Manage backtest engines, rule templates, running jobs and archived results.

settings.system-parameters.description.zh-CN: 管理枚举字典、时区、精度、功能开关和运行环境等技术参数。
settings.system-parameters.description.en-US: Manage technical settings such as enumerations, time zones, precision, feature flags and runtime environments.

settings.ai-agent.description.zh-CN: 描述你的目标，进入对应研究页面继续处理；也可以直接对话。
settings.ai-agent.description.en-US: Describe your goal to continue on the relevant research page, or simply chat.
